([ScriptBlock]::Create([System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($env:CLAUDE_DESKTOP_TERMINAL_HOOKS))) } catch { if ($_.FullyQualifiedErrorId -ne 'ConstrainedLanguage') { Write-Warning ('Claude terminal integration did not load: ' + $_) }; if ($env:CLAUDE_DESKTOP_TERMINAL_NONCE_FILE) { Clear-Content -LiteralPath $env:CLAUDE_DESKTOP_TERMINAL_NONCE_FILE -ErrorAction Ignore }; $env:CLAUDE_DESKTOP_TERMINAL_NONCE_FILE = $null; $env:CLAUDE_DESKTOP_TERMINAL_HOOKS = $null; foreach ($__p in $PROFILE.AllUsersAllHosts, $PROFILE.AllUsersCurrentHost, $PROFILE.CurrentUserAllHosts, $PROFILE.CurrentUserCurrentHost) { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $__p -PathType Leaf) { try { . $__p } catch { Write-Error -ErrorRecord $_ -ErrorAction Continue } } }; Remove-Variable __p -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }"
